note: Launch pads: walk onto one in a port scene to fly the encounter it names. Read by src/systems/flow/game_flow.gd. Coordinates are meters in the owning scene. 'arrive' is where the player lands back on foot after the flight; they face the pad. Labels are here so code stays name-free.

labels.arrive_complete: Back in port. Sector clear, +%d credits
labels.arrive_failed: Back in port. Your fighter limped home.
